rows.label: citation
rows.passage: Vid. Cicer. de Nat. Deor. Lib. I. Cap. 2.
rows.source: si maxime talis est deus, ut nulla gratia, nulla hominum caritate teneatur
rows.reason: Burlamaqui only names Cicero N.D. I (taken over with the Epicurean-indifference quotation from Pufendorf I.6.11); the candidate chunk treats the same Epicurean point but is not the cited chapter 2, so the link is weak. Also in Pufendorf.

rows.label: verbatim
rows.passage: Haec (Philosophia) nos primùm ad illorum (Deorum) cultum, deinde ad jus hominum, quod situm est in Generis humani Societate, tum ad modestiam magnitudinemque animi erudivit.
rows.source: haec nos primum ad illorum cultum, deinde ad ius hominum, quod situm est in generis humani societate, tum ad modestiam magnitudinemque animi erudivit
rows.reason: Burlamaqui prints the Latin of Tusc. I 64 (with French translation) in note 1; the same quotation of Cicero already stands in Barbeyrac's text (known_sources PUF34T1.p402). Also in Barbeyrac.
